purpose: isolated conservative adjacent-motion selector; not production
profile_requirement: maximum_view_index_gap is interpreted as maximum SOURCE FRAME gap and should be 1 for consecutive frames
near_stationary_policy: A total 3D pair angle below 0.25 degrees splits the segment; it is not accumulated, interpolated or treated as identity
ranking: measured center-longitude span, not observed pixel coverage or sum of Rodrigues x/y components
